sources.title: TOMY Company to Hold BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025 on October 11 and 12, 2025
sources.snippet:
Package:  

XENO XCALIBUR, a popular 3rd generation BEYBLADE BURST top, has been reissued using the "BEYBLADE X" mechanism.  
- Release date: Saturday, March 29, 2025   
- Reservations start: Saturday, March 22  
- Suggested retail price: 3,000 yen (tax included)  
- Copyright notice: (C) Homura Kawamoto, Hikaru Muno, Posuka Demizu, BBXProject, TV TOKYO  
(C) TOMY  
(C) Hiro Morita, BBBProject, TV TOKYO [...] About "BEYBLADE"

"BEYBLADE" battling tops, debuted in 1999, are a modernized version of traditional Japanese battling tops known as "bei-goma." Over 520 million units have been shipped cumulatively in more than 80 countries and regions around the world (as of April 2023). Each series has created a craze in many countries across the world including Japan. The fourth generation, BEYBLADE X started in July 2023 in Japan.

BEYBLADE X Official website:   
 (Japan)  
 (Asia) [...] TOKYO, March 21, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- TOMY Company, Ltd., based in Katsushika Ward, Tokyo, will host the first-ever world tournament for the modern version of "bei-goma" spinning tops, the "BEYBLADE X" series, titled "BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025." This event will take place on October 11 (Sat.) and 12 (Sun.), 2025, at RED TOKYO TOWER.
